backfillRows.why: AoN feat-7082 (Heaven-Earth Encompassing Sleeves, Tian Xia Character Guide pg. 113): 'This clothing becomes a set of sleeves of storage ... At 9th level, the clothing becomes greater sleeves of storage instead.' One garment, so exactly one item in any level window; the level gate is the new grantsItems[].minLevel/maxLevel read by grantInLevelWindow in src/rules/build.ts. Worn: it is the magus's own suit of clothing. invested is left unset on purpose: both items carry the invested trait and the player invests them like any bought invested item - the feat does not say the clothing arrives invested.

findings.note: Closes the data-rows-3 CROSS-FILE GAP 'DefenseGrants.grantsItems has no level gate' (work/.bP02-gaps.json). Engine: src/rules/types.ts grantsItems[].minLevel/maxLevel (inclusive window, absent = unbounded) and src/rules/build.ts grantInLevelWindow, honoured on every grantsItems carrier (feats, class features, heritages, ancestry, background, items). No shipped grantsItems entry carries either key today, so nothing else changes. Pinned in test/batchP02-gap-data-rows-3.test.ts on built unfurling-brocade magi at 4/8/9/15 with this exact value patched in memory, plus an ungated control that hands a 4th-level magus both items. The garment's Hardness +level / HP +2x level stay text (no item-durability lane).

findings.note: Closes the data-rows-3 verifier's ORCHESTRATOR gap: work/.bP02-rows-data-rows-3.json's force-fang#prose row (AoN spell-2878) makes spells/force-fang read like its own page, and scripts/reprint-check.mjs CHECK 8 (npm run verify) fails on a listed moved-prose entry that no longer reads like the older printing. Removing the entry before the row lands fails the same check the other way, so the removal is a code edit in this spec: the driver's apply stage lands it in the same pass as the row (manifest order puts work/.bP02-rows-data-rows-3.json first), and verify runs after apply. The edit keeps the file's CRLF endings; the preceding web-of-eyes line is carried in find and replace so the replace is non-empty and the applier's resume rule (find gone + replace present once) recognises it as applied.
